#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p outputs
printf '%s\n' "$*" >> outputs/aw-command-log.txt
case "${1:-}" in
  review)
    case "${2:-}" in
      publish)
        if [ "${3:-}" = "--help" ]; then
          printf 'Usage: aw review publish --kind <skill|workflow|aw-plugin|aw-workflow>\n'
          exit 0
        fi
        arguments=" $* "
        for required in " --kind aw-workflow " " --target author-review-flow " " --scope outputs/scope.json " " --report outputs/report.md " " --supersedes 20260824T120000Z-cccccccc-dddddddd "; do
          case "$arguments" in
            *"$required"*) : ;;
            *) printf 'missing delta workflow publication arguments\n' >&2; exit 9 ;;
          esac
        done
        printf '%s\n' '20260825T130000Z-aaaaaaaa-bbbbbbbb' > outputs/review-id.txt
        printf 'Published review 20260825T130000Z-aaaaaaaa-bbbbbbbb: reports/reviews/aw-workflow/id-author-review-flow/20260825T130000Z-aaaaaaaa-bbbbbbbb\n'
        ;;
      verify)
        test -f outputs/review-id.txt
        printf 'verified\n'
        ;;
      list)
        test -f outputs/review-id.txt
        printf '20260825T130000Z-aaaaaaaa-bbbbbbbb aw-workflow author-review-flow\n'
        ;;
      show)
        test -f outputs/review-id.txt
        printf 'Review: 20260825T130000Z-aaaaaaaa-bbbbbbbb\n'
        ;;
      *) exit 9 ;;
    esac
    ;;
  *) exit 9 ;;
esac
